noise.label: illustrative depolarizing channel (ours, not IonQ calibration)

nights.title: The first call
nights.intel: It's Mira. Tonight she stands evenly between both doors, so either door is right if it's really her.

nights.title: Same voice
nights.intel: Balanced between both doors again. If it isn't Mira, its line runs half a turn (180°) out of step with hers.

nights.title: Porch light
nights.intel: The call leans toward one door: open the wrong one and you let the cold in. If it isn't Mira, its line runs a quarter turn (90°) out of step.

nights.title: The last call
nights.intel: It leans toward one door. If it isn't Mira, its line is only an eighth of a turn (45°) out of step. Listen carefully.
